approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and email content.
notes: Page-level UNKNOWN contexts must not manufacture the missing side of an RFI Question/Response pair.

title: RFI role aggregation accuracy
objective: Preserve explicit RFI Question and Response semantics when the same source also contains page-level UNKNOWN contexts; use MIXED only when both explicit sides exist or a source already reports MIXED.
